project.project_title: American English VO for short animated video

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello dear,

My sincere apologies for the late response. I had an emergency and needed to take a few days off. Thank you for being patient and for providing several takes; I truly appreciate the work you put in.

Having reviewed them, I think Take Two is stronger than the rest, particularly regarding the pauses. However, we would like to try one more version with greater energy and liveliness in the delivery.

I’m sharing an AI-generated sample now solely as a reference for the tone and energy we want to achieve. Naturally, your vibrant voice will bring it to life much better!

I know we’re in different time zones, but please tell me when you can record today, and I’ll ensure that I’m online and available to respond.

Best regards!

value_updates.energy_and_liveliness: More energy and liveliness than the reviewed takes
